scope: Prospective RET new-source PRIOR-ART and SCIENTIFIC VALUE only; not new-case identity/assay validation and not completed primary-source coverage review.

prior_primary.title: Activity of sunitinib in extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma.
prior_primary.observation: Primary abstract describes10progressive metastatic translocatedEMC patients, limited transcriptome/IHC/biochemical target analysis, and explicitly reports RET expressed AND activated. No site-specific peptide, antibody, specimen-condition or measured-sample denominator is exposed in the abstract.
prior_primary.short_primary_quote: Among putative sunitinib targets, only RET was expressed and activated in analysed samples.
prior_primary.coverage_limit: Full2014primary/direct assay/case tables unavailable in prior cloud receipt; no assumption that Y905/Y1062 were absent or that biochemical prior art was merely RNA. Two2012sunitinibcases are source-described continuation precursor, not independent2014replication.
prior_primary.excluded_scope: Do not explore structural rearrangement mechanisms; diagnostic fusion labels only eligibility context.

search.interpretation: Metadata query recovery, not full evaluation of every hit. Direct exactsite query misses general biochemical wording, so its sparse hits cannot support no published phosphorylation.

scientific_validity_limits: Direct-site abundance with matched total can support a sample-level comparative phosphorylation proxy; it is not calibrated fractional site occupancy without matched assay calibration.

Y905 and Y1062 are separate prespecified sites, with potentially different functional roles; phosphorylation alone does not show receptor dependence, a cell compartment, RET-exclusive kinase signal or clinical susceptibility.
No imputed phosphopeptide absence, RNA denominator substitution or TOPAS-only score substitution for direct RET site/total.
Bulk tissue mixture, donor repetitions, specimen-site/treatment and preanalytical handling remain source/assay comparability constraints assessed independently by radiotherapy.
value_decision: Generic first RET activation or activity beyond known RNA is not novel. A complete fixed comparator phosphosite/total pattern might still be distinct, but must materially add a discriminating measurement beyond published limited activation; site and donor/case details, fullsource novelty comparison and eligible assay remain pending before values. A platform demonstration or richer cohort alone is not a disease discovery.
recommendation: Retain original frozen plan, add a dated prior-art scope amendment before values clarifying already-published activation and exact distinct comparative endpoint/use; do not change sites/controls to hunt positive. No manuscript/promotion until all valid source/novelty/value gates pass.
decision: PENDING authenticated new-source and distinct useful comparative measurement, not endorsed finding
methylation_scope: Newer long-read/classifier gates remain separate and awaited; no DMR values read.
